newsitem.title: USA: Levi Strauss & Co. president to retire.
newsitem.headline: Levi Strauss & Co. president to retire.

text.p: Levi Strauss & Co. said Thursday President and Chief Operating Officer Thomas Tusher will retire from the apparel company on June 1, 1997.
Peter Jacobi, president of Levi Strauss International has been named as his sucessor.

Levi Strauss said in a statement Tusher will remain president and chief operating officer through the end of its fiscal year on Nov. 24. Jacobi will become president and chief operating officer of Levi Strauss on Dec. 1.
Tusher, 55, will remain as an adviser and consultant until his retirement on June 1 after more than 27 years with the company.
